Welcome

About

A production leader with a hospitality heart and a sales-floor start.

Neranjan Madushan Kulathilaka is a production and quality leader working across New Zealand's poultry and automated food processing sector. Born and raised in Sri Lanka, he is the eldest son of Kamani Dissanayaka and H.P. Kulathilaka. He currently serves as Production & Grading Supervisor at Ewing Poultry Ltd in Nelson, where he runs daily grading floor operations, rosters permanent and temporary staff, and acts as lead operator across the MOBA-2500 and MOBA Omnia grading systems — handling weight calibration, configuration, and first-line troubleshooting.

His career began in technology sales, as a Sales Specialist with an authorised Microsoft, Adobe, and Oracle distribution partner, before he moved into hospitality — working as a hotelier across several 5-star properties in Sri Lanka and the Maldives. That grounding in service and client standards carried through into his move to New Zealand and into food production.

His work today sits at the intersection of throughput and compliance: holding the line on HACCP and Ministry for Primary Industries requirements, maintaining Risk Management Programme documentation, and keeping audit trails ready for major retail and export accounts including McDonald's and Woolworths.
